_readme: Updated manually, weekly, from Google Business Profile Insights, Instagram Insights, and Google Search Console (none of these have a public API usable without the salon's own account access, so this file is hand-entered rather than automated). Add one object to 'entries' per week. Leave a field null if that number isn't available yet — the dashboard will show '—' rather than guessing.

fields.gbp_views: Google Business Profile: total profile views (Insights tab)
fields.gbp_calls: Google Business Profile: call button clicks
fields.gbp_reviewCount: Google Business Profile: total review count
fields.gbp_avgRating: Google Business Profile: average star rating
